description: Image Description: The image features two small birds, likely sparrows, perched on a rough, textured stone surface. The foreground bird is in sharp focus, standing on the edge of a granite-like ledge with its body oriented slightly to the left. It has a brownish-gray plumage with streaked patterns on its back and wings, a light-colored breast, and a short, conical beak typical of seed-eating birds. Its legs are slender and orange-red, gripping the stone firmly
